description: Captain's settings for this project. Compose ignores top-level keys that start with x-, so the file still works everywhere.

tasks.description: Named commands that run in a service, such as a database migration. The project page lists them and runs them with docker compose exec.

additionalProperties.description: One task: the service it runs in and its command.

service.description: The service to run the task in. Its container must be running.

command.description: The command. A string runs with sh -c; a list runs as it is.
